vb_textbox.text: During the game, the color of the gnomes will alternate regularly. The gnomes are correlated by color. The Green gnome = Purple gnome and the Red gnome = the Brown gnome, so try to pick them as a pairing. Always monitor the points you receive after each trial and if you get 2 or 3 low point trials in a row, switch colors/pairings. Lastly, only switch colors/pairings if you have to... If you are on a points streak and are doing well, let it ride!!!
